name: @dsh-external/dsh-project-memory
description: Project-level knowledge and development-state memory for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown docs as source of truth, a state system (task/progress/git/handoff) that survives restarts, compaction, and branch switches, and memory atoms recalled by sparse routing. Host-side cordis plugin plus one sidebar panel.
author: iverins

scripts.setup: npm run extract:harness && node scripts/resolve-host-deps.mjs @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools && node scripts/resolve-host-deps.mjs @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot && npm run link:harness
scripts.test:host: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/tools.mjs && node tests/cordis-semantics.mjs && node tests/inject.mjs && node tests/safety.mjs && node tests/degrade.mjs && node tests/continuity.mjs && node tests/root.mjs && node tests/compat.mjs && node tests/patch.mjs && node tests/mount.mjs && node tests/loop.mjs && node tests/panel.mjs && node tests/client.mjs
